info.title: Task Authority (proposed service, prototype)
info.description: Prototype API. Not an existing Auth0 public endpoint set.

post.summary: Build a coalesced, rate-limited reviewer queue digest
Validate a constrained approval policy document

get.summary: List policy versions and active/shadow pointers

post.summary: Activate a policy or set its shadow pointer
Replay recorded facts and budgets under a candidate version

get.summary: List approvals the current reviewer is eligible to decide

post.summary: Atomically decide at most five operation-bound approvals
Take a short exclusive reviewer lease
Explicitly escalate a pending approval through CIBA
Reconcile a verified provider event and flag unclaimed effects
Establish a bounded user- or organization-owned delegation
Register an exact operation against a delegation (idempotent on operationKey)

get.summary: Inspect the authorization lifecycle of an operation

post.summary: Request a human decision when required

get.summary: Read approval progress and the exact operation to review

post.summary: Cancel an unclaimed operation (never reverses a claimed one)
Poll a CIBA approval for its outcome (trusted backend)

get.summary: Investigator audit query by correlation id, operation, delegation, type or reason
Liveness and datastore readiness (no sensitive details)

bearer.description: Backend (M2M) token, or a human token for decisions/reads. Optional X-Task-Authority-Subject header forwards a verified human token.
